results.snippet: This paper presents an overview of the VQualA 2025 Challenge on Engagement Prediction for Short Videos, held in conjunction with ICCV 2025. To support this goal, the challenge uses a new short-form UGC dataset featuring engagement metrics derived from real-world user interactions. results.title: GEM-4D: Geometry-Enhanced Video World Models for Robot Manipulation
results.snippet: Video world models can generate realistic futures from a single instruction, but they often fail to track the same physical points consistently across time. As a result, the generated videos appear plausible, yet lack the physical grounding required for reliable action execution, such as robot manipulation. We present GEM-4D, a geometry-grounded video world model that resolves this limitation by injecting dense 4D correspondence supervision distilled from a pretrained geometry foundation model into the video generative backbone during training. results.title: The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index
results.snippet: Foundation model developers are among the world's most important companies. As these companies become increasingly consequential, how do their transparency practices evolve? The 2025 Foundation Model Transparency Index is the third edition of an annual effort to characterize and quantify the transparency of foundation model developers. The 2025 FMTI introduces new indicators related to data acquisition, usage data, and monitoring and evaluates companies like Alibaba, DeepSeek, and xAI for the first time. results.title: The Open Ant: A Robot Platform for Reinforcement Learning Research
results.snippet: Reinforcement learning (RL) research has demonstrated success in both physical and simulated domains; however, the predominant methodology remains rooted in simulations. The predominance of simulations makes translating research to physical reality uncertain for both algorithms and researchers. We propose a physical platform that is designed to simplify the transition. In this paper, we present the Open Ant: a physical variant of the commonly used Gymnasium Ant environment, along with a simulation. We demonstrate that competent walking policies can be learned from scratch in approximately one…

results.title: Robot Policy Evaluation for Sim-to-Real Transfer: A Benchmarking Perspective
results.snippet: Current vision-based robotics simulation benchmarks have significantly advanced robotic manipulation research. However, robotics is fundamentally a real-world problem, and evaluation for real-world applications has lagged behind in evaluating generalist policies. In this paper, we discuss challenges and desiderata in designing benchmarks for generalist robotic manipulation policies for the goal of sim-to-real policy transfer. results.title: LIBERO-VPro: Benchmarking Closed-Loop Visual Robustness of Robotic Foundation Models
results.snippet: Robotic foundation models achieve impressive performance on standard manipulation benchmarks, yet these evaluations typically assume clean, timely, and consistent visual observations throughout execution. We introduce LIBERO-VPro, a benchmark for systematically evaluating the closed-loop visual robustness of robotic foundation models by perturbing the visual evidence available during execution. LIBERO-VPro covers four complementary dimensions, including Visual Evidence Degradation, Camera Staleness, Visual Source Consistency, and Task-Relevant Scene Variation, spanning 12 challenge categories…

results.title: Equivalence Between Wasserstein and Value-Aware Loss for Model-based Reinforcement Learning
results.snippet: Learning a generative model is a key component of model-based reinforcement learning. findings.point: LIBERO-VPro 指出：机器人基础模型在标准操作基准上的评测通常假设执行过程中视觉观测干净、及时且一致，因此这类基准所界定的可比性仅在理想视觉条件下成立，其能力边界不覆盖闭环视觉鲁棒性。
findings.evidence: 摘要原文：'these evaluations typically assume clean, timely, and consistent visual observations throughout execution'；该基准通过在执行过程中扰动可获得的视觉证据，系统评测机器人基础模型的闭环视觉鲁棒性（closed-loop visual robustness）。

findings.point: 面向 sim-to-real 的策略评测被单列为独立问题：有工作提出三条基准设计要求——(1) 用高视觉保真度仿真改善 sim-to-real，(2) 通过系统性提升任务复杂度与场景扰动来评估鲁棒性，(3) 量化真机性能与仿真对应结果之间的性能对齐度。
findings.evidence: 摘要给出 1) utilizing high visual-fidelity simulation for improved sim-to-real transfer, 2) evaluating policies by systematically increasing task complexity and scenario perturbation to assess robustness, 3) quantifying performance alignment between real-world performance and its simulation counterparts；并指出 'robotics is fundamentally a real-world problem'，面向真实世界应用的评测在通用策略上滞后。

results.title: RealD$^2$iff: Bridging Real-World Gap in Robot Manipulation via Depth Diffusion
results.snippet: Robot manipulation in the real world is fundamentally constrained by the visual sim2real gap, where depth observations collected in simulation fail to reflect the complex noise patterns inherent to real sensors. In this work, inspired by the denoising capability of diffusion models, we invert the conventional perspective and propose a clean-to-noisy paradigm that learns to synthesize noisy depth, thereby bridging the visual sim2real gap through purely simulation-driven robotic learning. results.title: Advancing Open-source World Models
results.snippet: We present LingBot-World, an open-sourced world simulator stemming from video generation. Positioned as a top-tier world model, LingBot-World offers the following features. (1) It maintains high fidelity and robust dynamics in a broad spectrum of environments, including realism, scientific contexts, cartoon styles, and beyond. (2) It enables a minute-level horizon while preserving contextual consistency over time, which is also known as "long-term memory". results.title: Simplifying ROS2 controllers with a modular architecture for robot-agnostic reference generation
results.snippet: This paper introduces a novel modular architecture for ROS2 that decouples the logic required to acquire, validate, and interpolate references from the control laws that track them. The design includes a dedicated component, named Reference Generator, that receives references, in the form of either single points or trajectories, from external nodes (e.g., planners), and writes single-point references at the controller's sampling period via the existing ros2_control chaining mechanism to downstream controllers. # 机器人操作与世界模型：前沿增量、奠基工作与产业信号调研报告（2024–2026）

**元信息**：日期 2026-10-12（UTC）｜领域：具身智能 / 机器人操作（robot manipulation）/ 世界模型（world models）｜可引用检索源：34 条（[1]–[34]），其中与本主题**直接相关**者约 13 条（[4][10][12][14][20][21][22][23][24][25][28][29][30]），其余为弱相关或检索噪声。

**证据基础与限制声明（先读）**

- 本报告的候选证据集中存在明显**检索噪声**：例如 [13]（短视频参与度预测）、[17]（人脸修复）、[1][32]（语音隐私/语音评测）、[19]（临床问答）、[26][27][33]（GitHub 软件工程）等与"机器人操作世界模型"无直接关系。这些条目**不进入核心论证**，仅在方法论层面（如 [3] 的 workshop 层级、[27] 的开源可持续性）作旁证或直接排除。
- 候选块**普遍缺失量化热度信号**（引用数、GitHub star、下载量、榜单排名）。因此全文的"热度"一栏除极少数可从标题/venue 推断者外，均标注 `> 待核实`；"关注度"仅为**基于 venue 与发表时间的弱推断**，不得当作真实社区热度。
- 时间标注：候选块给出的 `year` 为准；未给出月份者，用 arXiv 编号 `YYMM` 前缀推断月份并**明示为推断**。

---

## 1. 进展与热点（Progress & Hotspots）

**一句话增量判断**：相对 2023–2024 的"视频生成式世界模型"基线，2025–2026 的增量集中在三点——(a) **动作与世界模型耦合**（action world model）、(b) **3D/几何表征替代纯像素预测**、(c) **世界模型被当作"策略评测环境"而不再只是生成器**；同时评测侧出现"闭环视觉鲁棒性"这一新切口 [12][14][20][21][24]。

**最新进展（近 1–2 年，2025–2026）**

2. **用途转移**：从"生成未来帧"转向"评估策略"（[24]），即世界模型被当作可交互环境使用。
3. **评测切口**：从"理想视觉下的成功率"转向"闭环视觉鲁棒性"（[12]）与"真机-仿真对齐度"（[10]）。

**检索噪声排除说明**：[13]（VQualA 短视频参与度预测）与 [17]（NTIRE 人脸修复）虽被抽取为"最新进展"，但与机器人操作世界模型**无主题关联**，属检索召回误命中，予以排除；[15]（基础模型透明度指数）与 [29] 相关，归入第 5 节。

---

## 3. 蓝海与缺口（Blue Ocean & Gaps）

**一句话增量判断**：最清晰的无人区是 **"世界模型输出与可执行动作之间的物理一致性/可验证性"**——[14] 明确指出现有视频世界模型"看似合理但缺乏可靠动作执行所需的物理 grounding" [14]，而把世界模型当评测环境（[24]）的前提恰恰是这一致性成立。

**缺口清单（每条带来源与不确定度）**

1. **物理点跨时一致性（physical point tracking consistency）**：现有视频世界模型做不到对同一物理点的时序一致跟踪，导致生成视频无法支撑动作执行 [14]。→ 这是**方法论级缺口**，非工程调参问题。`置信度：较高（单一来源 [14]，需交叉验证）`。
2. **闭环视觉鲁棒性不在标准基准的覆盖面内**：标准操作基准"假设执行期视觉观测干净、及时、一致" [12]，因此其界定的可比性只成立于理想视觉条件，能力边界被系统性高估 [12]。→ 蓝海：把"视觉证据被扰动/延迟/缺失"作为一等公民的基准设计 [12]。
3. **真机通用策略（generalist policies）评测手段缺失**：仿真基准显著推进了操作研究，但"robotics is fundamentally a real-world problem"，真实世界评测落后 [10]。→ 蓝海：低成本真机评测协议与共享硬件 [10]。
4. **真机-仿真性能对齐度的量化**：[10] 把"quantifying performance alignment between real-world performance and its simulation counterparts"列为基准设计三要求之一，但候选证据未提供任何已实现的量化方法 [10]。
5. **深度观测的 sim2real 噪声反转**：仿真深度不反映真实传感器噪声模式 [28]，RealD²iff 只是初步尝试 [28]。
6. **数据集侧空白**：候选证据中**没有任何**操作世界模型的公开数据集条目（无 Open X-Embodiment / DROID 等一手来源）→ `> 待核实`，这是本报告最大的证据缺口，需优先补检。

**竞争空白判断**：评测侧的"鲁棒性 × 真机对齐"组合（[10]+[12]）目前看是低竞争、高杠杆位置；表征侧的"3D/Gaussian × 操作"（[20][14]）已有玩家，属竞争区而非蓝海。

---

## 4. 瓶颈与拐点（Bottleneck & Inflection）

**一句话增量判断**：当前瓶颈**不是算力而是评测与物理一致性**；拐点信号是"世界模型从生成器变为评测环境"（[24]）与"基准开始攻击理想视觉假设"（[12]），二者若在 2026H2–2027 合并成标准实践，则构成真拐点 `[P]`。

**瓶颈分层**

| 瓶颈 | 证据 | 是否临近拐点 | 拐点信号 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 物理一致性/可执行性 | 生成视频"appear plausible, yet lack the physical grounding required for reliable action execution" [14] | 未 | 出现"生成未来 → 直接执行成功"的第三方真机复现 `> 待核实` |
| 评测（仿真 vs 真机） | 真机评测落后于通用策略需求；提出三条基准设计要求 [10] | 接近 | 真机评测被 workshop/主会专门议题化（RSS 2025 Workshop 已是信号）[10] |
| 基准的能力边界失真 | 标准基准假设干净/及时/一致观测 [12] | 接近 | 以扰动视觉证据为核心的基准被广泛采用 [12] |
| 数据（深度/观测分布） | 仿真深度无法反映真实噪声模式 [28] | 未 | 深度扩散类方法被独立复现 [28] |
| 开源可持续性（旁证） | 开源项目维护与质量保障存在系统性挑战 [27][33] | 已长期存在 | — （与机器人世界模型仅类比相关，**降级为线索**）|
